en: My presence is necessary to those who{SAUT}flee reality. Defying me is so foolish...
You are but puny, pitiful children to me.{SAUT}Give up now, and cast yourselves away.
Everyone, hold out as long as you can!{SAUT}We have to keeping playing that movie!
We need the minds of the theatergoers{SAUT}to change! Please!
C'mon, you've gotta hang in there!{SAUT}We'll do our best over here too!
Innumerable humans have come here,{SAUT}craving structure and safety.{PAGE}Your resistance to my salvation is{SAUT}nothing but utter conceitedness.
